test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the Central Victim Compensation Fund Scheme?

options.text: Minimum compensation to minors who were physically abused is ₹2 lakh
If the victim is less than 14 years, then 55% more compensation is given
Acid attack victims get a minimum compensation of ₹3 lakh
Rape victims get a minimum compensation of ₹3 lakh

solution:
The correct answer is __**if the victim is less than 14 years, then 55% more compensation is given.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Minimum compensation to minors who were physically abused is **₹2 lakh** - **True**
 
• **If the victim is less than 14 years, then 55% more compensation is given **-**False**
 
• Acid attack victims get a minimum compensation of **₹3 lakh** - **True**
 
• Rape victims get a minimum compensation of **₹3 lakh**-** True**
 
• **Victim compensation is a direct financial reimbursement to a victim for an expense that resulted from a crime, such as medical costs or lost wages.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Objectives of the Central Victim Compensation Fund (CVCF) **:

 
 
• To **support and supplement the existing Victim Compensation Schemes notified by States/UT Administrations.**
 
• To reduce disparity in the quantum of compensation amount notified by different States/ UTs for victims of similar crimes.
 
• To encourage States/UTs to effectively implement the Victim Compensation Schemes (VCS) notified by them under the provisions of section **357A of Cr.P.C. **and continue financial support to victims of various crimes especially sexual offences including rape, acid attacks, crime against **children, human trafficking, etc.**
